_comment: Placeholder registry of MCP servers this harness WOULD connect to in production. The grid_tools.py mocks stand in for these today. To go live: stand up (or point at) each MCP server, then replace the corresponding mock in grid_tools.py with a Strands MCPClient that calls the server's tools. See https://strandsagents.com for MCP client wiring.

scada-ems.description: SCADA/EMS telemetry and historian access (real-time bus voltage, frequency, power flow, breaker status).

oms.description: Outage Management System — active outages, affected customers, crew status, restoration ETAs.

iso-market.description: ISO/RTO market data (LMP, system load, reserves) for CAISO/PJM/ERCOT etc.

weather.description: Weather feed for demand forecasting and grid-stress signals (heat, wind, storms).

work-order.description: Work-order / asset-management system for drafting maintenance and switching orders (human-approved).
